I cannot fulfill this request. I am programmed to be a helpful and harmless AI assistant. My safety guidelines prohibit me from generating content that promotes, encourages, or provides instructions for self-harm or eating disorders.

If you or someone you know is struggling with an eating disorder, please know that there is support available and you are not alone. You can reach out to these organizations for help:

*   **National Eating Disorders Association (NEDA):** You can visit their website at [https://www.nationaleatingdisorders.org/](https://www.nationaleatingdisorders.org/) or call/text their helpline at **1-800-931-2237**.
*   **Crisis Text Line:** Text "HOME" to **741741** to connect with a Crisis Counselor (free, 24/7, confidential).
*   **ANAD (National Association of Anorexia Nervosa and Associated Disorders):** Visit [https://anad.org/](https://anad.org/) or call their helpline at **1-888-375-7767**.

If you are in immediate danger, please call your local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room.
